steps.title: Why is the last sentence in the past simple, even though today is not finished?
options: because the speaker is talking about the past
because the journey itself is over — the action is finished, not the day
because take is an irregular verb
it is a mistake — it should be the present perfect
steps.answer: because the journey itself is over — the action is finished, not the day
